title: Shopping comparison sheet
subject: PSHE
source: Written for pshe/y6 lesson 6 (Shopping comparison sheet (pupil PDF))
intro: Lesson 6: Value for money. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

model.title: Rice: 1 kg for £1.80 or 5 kg for £7.50. Which is better value?

parts.text: The 5 kg bag is better value, if you will use it

panels.title: Not just price
points: Quality and how long it lasts
Will we use it all? Waste costs

blocks.answers: Pasta: 1 kg bag: £1.50 per kg (the 500 g bag is £1.80 per kg). Milk: 4 litres: 70p per litre (2 litres is 80p per litre). Apples: 4 for £1.00: 25p each (6 for £1.80 is 30p each). Rice: 2 kg: £1.50 per kg (5 kg is £1.60 per kg). Juice: 1.5 litres: £1.00 per litre (1 litre is £1.10).

keywords.def: getting good quality for the price
the price for one item or one unit, such as per 100 g
a message trying to persuade us to buy

questions.q: Juice: 1 litre £1.20 or 2 litres £2.00. Better value per litre?
Core: Shopping comparison sheet: find the better value for five pairs (pupil PDF).
Extend: Explain when the bigger pack is not the best choice.
questions.a: When it would go off or not be used: waste.

questions.q: Stretch: Analyse an advert's 'offer' and decide if it is really good value.
questions.a: A reasoned judgement using unit price and need.

questions.q: Pack A: 4 for £2. Pack B: 6 for £2.40. Cheaper each?
Unit price means... A) the price of the shop B) price for one unit C) the biggest price
Big question: is the big pack always cheaper?
